items.informal_name: Weight Homomorphism on Single Finite Support Function
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (s : σ) (r : R), (Finsupp.weight w) (Finsupp.single s r) = r • w s
items.informal_description: For any index $ s $ and scalar $ r $, the weighted sum homomorphism $ \text{weight}_w $ applied to the finite support function that assigns $ r $ to $ s $ and zero to all other indices equals $ r \cdot w(s) $.

items.informal_name: Weight Homomorphism on Single Index: $\text{weight}(\delta_s^c, f) = f(s) \cdot c$
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq σ] (s : σ) (c : M) (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight (Pi.single s c)) f = f s • c
items.informal_description: For any index $ s \in \sigma $, element $ c \in M $, and finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 R $, the weighted sum homomorphism evaluated at the function $ \delta_s^c $ (which is $ c $ at $ s $ and zero elsewhere) applied to $ f $ equals $ f(s) \cdot c $. This expresses that the homomorphism acts as scalar multiplication at the specified index when restricted to single-index functions.

items.informal_name: Weight Homomorphism Applied to Single Index Function Yields Corresponding Vector
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (s : σ) (f : σ →₀ R),
  (Finsupp.weight (Pi.single s 1)) f = f s
items.informal_description: For any index $s$ in $\sigma$ and finite support function $f : \sigma \to_0 R$, applying the weight homomorphism to the function that is 1 at $s$ and 0 elsewhere results in $f(s)$. In symbols, $\text{weight}(\delta_s)(f) = f(s)$, where $\delta_s$ denotes the finite support function with $\delta_s(s) = 1$ and $\delta_s(i) = 0$ for $i \neq s$.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Evaluation: $ \text{weight } w f = \sum_{i \in \text{support } f} c_i \cdot w(i) $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 R $, the weight function applied to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all $ i $ in the support of $ f $ of $ c \cdot w(i) $, where $ c $ is the coefficient of $ i $ in $ f $ and $ w : \sigma \to M $ is a function assigning vectors to indices.

items.informal_name: Linear Combination of Single Index Vector
items.type:
∀ (α : Type u_1) (M : Type u_2) (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (c : M) (a : α) (f : α →₀ R) [inst_3 : DecidableEq α], (Finsupp.linearCombination R (Pi.single a c)) f = f a • c
items.informal_description: For any element $c$ in the module $M$, index $a$ in $\alpha$, and finite support function $f : \alpha \to_0 R$ with decidable equality on $\alpha$, the linear combination map evaluated at the function $\mathrm{single}_a(c)$ (which is $c$ at index $a$ and zero elsewhere) and $f$ yields the scalar multiplication of $f(a)$ with $c$, i.e., $\mathrm{linearCombination}_R(\mathrm{single}_a(c), f) = f(a) \cdot c$.

items.informal_name: Linear Combination of Single Term Equals Scalar Multiple
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : α → M} (c : R) (a : α), (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) (Finsupp.single a c) = c • v a
items.informal_description: For any semiring $R$, index type $\alpha$, $R$-module $M$, and function $v : \alpha \to M$, the linear combination map applied to the finite support function with a single non-zero coefficient $c$ at index $a$ equals $c \cdot v(a)$.
